text: First terminal viewer implemented with optional tui extra, connect --view, attach/offline/plain modes, keyboard tabs/files/logs/activity, stale-state labels and safe output. Consistent tabs across widths use split Files preview at >=100 columns. Explicit Ctrl-C binding and root-label preservation are regression-tested. Persistent monitor survives exit; stop via monitor remove. Full WP8a semantic campaign projection remains open.
